name: bounded_priority_queue
description: Priority queue with fixed max capacity. When full, lower priority items are dropped or rejected.

requirements.description: Pop returns highest priority item first.
examples: push(item, priority=1), push(item, priority=10) -> pop() yields priority 10

requirements.description: Respect max capacity boundary by dropping lower-priority items when full.
examples: cap=2, push p=5, p=10, push p=15 -> p=5 dropped
edge_cases: push p=1 into full queue with p=5, p=10 -> new item dropped
